cards.title: Visual style direction (style preset)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Default to Flat 2.0 with strong signifiers. Heuristic: pick the style whose strained principle (see section 1.10) your product can afford; reserve fashionable styles for marketing surfaces and keep the app surface on a durable base.

cards.title: Hierarchy strength (how dramatic the contrast between levels is)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Default balanced (1.25, two weights, three text colors). Heuristic: the builder should keep adjacent levels at least about 10% apart in size (L02 DC-L02-10) *or* 200 apart in weight [inferred], so levels never read as "almost the same".

cards.title: Emphasis budget (focal points, primary actions, accent area)
cards.block: Foundations > Visual language > Hierarchy > Emphasis budget
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Default strict for app surfaces, moderate for marketing. Heuristic: if you need two primaries, one of them is secondary.

cards.title: Density voice (compact, comfortable, spacious)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Comfortable for app surfaces, spacious for marketing, compact as a user option for data-heavy tools. Heuristic: the denser the layout, the stronger the grouping and signifiers must be [inferred from S-L15-004].

cards.title: Grouping strategy (space, containers or lines)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Space first; add a container only when content types mix, items sit in a grid, or spacing cannot be controlled; use lines for long lists. Keep inner:outer spacing at 1:2 or more (L03 DC-L03-24).

cards.title: Color scheme strategy and accent proportion
cards.block: Foundations > Color > Scheme strategy (principle level; L01 owns ramps and roles)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Neutral + one accent, with analogous tints for surfaces. Heuristic: harmonize the large areas, contrast the small important ones.

cards.title: Composition and grid model
cards.block: Foundations > Layout > Composition model (principle level; L03 owns columns, gutters, breakpoints)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Column grid for app surfaces; hierarchical or bento for marketing feature sections. Heuristic: every grid break should be nameable ("this hero breaks the grid to signal X").

cards.title: Balance and alignment axis
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Start-aligned everywhere; center only single-focus moments with short text.

cards.title: Interactive signifier strength
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Balanced, with strong signifiers forced for primary actions. Heuristic from NN/g: go minimal only when density is low, layouts are conventional and key actions already stand out; all three must hold [S-L15-004].

cards.title: Optical correction policy (polish automation)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Auto-correct known cases, suggest for custom assets. Heuristic from Bjango: prefer a formula to eyeballing when one exists, "No matter what, you're still going to have to use your best judgement" [S-L15-058].

cards.title: Builder feedback mode (critique strictness)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Coach by default for engineers; strict for teams shipping to production; metrics panel as an advanced view. Heuristic: every message names the principle, so users learn the vocabulary (Williams: "Once you can name the problem, you can find the solution" [S-L15-070]).
